source: docs/PLANT_CARE.md 4.D — family preservation catalog (methods, safety, combos, supplies)
notes: Data only: no preservation logic lives in Python. Safety copy points at USDA/NCHFP/Ball tested recipes and never states processing times.

water_bath_canning.label: Water-bath canning
supplies: Bottled lemon juice or citric acid

pressure_canning.label: Pressure canning
supplies: Pressure canner with a tested gauge

low_acid.title: Low-acid — Pressure Canner Required
low_acid.message: Pressure canning is required for plain low-acid vegetables, meats and mixed soups. Never water-bath can unacidified low-acid food: botulism risk. Follow a tested USDA / NCHFP / Ball recipe for load, venting and processing time.
low_acid.source: USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning / NCHFP / Ball Blue Book

high_acid.title: High-acid — Water-Bath Safe
high_acid.message: Water-bath canning is safe for high-acid foods. Tomatoes and figs need added acid: bottled lemon juice or citric acid per USDA, or the tested recipe's ratio.
high_acid.source: USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning / NCHFP / Ball Blue Book

unknown.title: Acidity not recorded — verify before canning
unknown.message: This species has no recorded USDA acidity class. Follow a tested USDA / NCHFP / Ball recipe rather than an untested one.
unknown.source: USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning / NCHFP / Ball Blue Book

combos.label: Marinara sauce
combos.note: Paste tomatoes make the thickest sauce; acidify with bottled lemon juice or citric acid per the tested recipe.
supplies: Bottled lemon juice or citric acid

combos.label: Salsa
combos.note: Use a tested salsa ratio: adding more low-acid vegetables (onion, pepper) without more acid makes it unsafe to water-bath.
supplies: Bottled lemon juice or citric acid

combos.label: Dill pickles
combos.note: Cucumbers are low-acid: they are only water-bath safe once pickled at a tested vinegar strength.

combos.label: Pesto cubes
combos.note: Freeze in oil: garlic-in-oil kept at room temperature is a botulism risk.

combos.label: Berry jam
combos.note: Follow the pectin insert's tested sugar/acid ratio for set and safety.

combos.label: Pickled jalapeños
combos.note: Peppers are low-acid; the tested vinegar ratio is what makes them water-bath safe.

combos.label: Applesauce
combos.note: Apples are high-acid: water-bath safe, with or without sugar.

combos.label: Ratatouille / veggie soup base
combos.note: Mixed vegetable bases are low-acid — pressure can only, never water-bath.
supplies: Pressure canner with a tested gauge

combos.label: Dried Italian herb blend
combos.note: Dry herbs at low heat and keep them airtight; they lose aroma in light.

combos.label: Squash & carrot freezer packs
combos.note: Blanch first (see each crop's blanching time) so the texture survives the freezer.
